words.d: If someone is corrupt, they break the law for money or fame.

t: 传送， 传递， 输送； 传播， 传染

words.d: To transmit something means to pass it from one person or place to another.

t: 消耗； 消费； 食用
words.s: Alcohol consumption is increasing every year.
words.sz: 酒的消费每年都在上升。
words.d: The consumption of food or drink is the act of eating or drinking it.

t: 保留剧目； 保留剧目轮演； 库存， 储备； 仓库

words.sz: 你有如此美麗的淡褐色眼睛。

t: 趣味； 热情， 狂热

words.s: After three months of drought, the vegetation and trees started dying.
words.d: A drought is a long period of time in which little or no rain falls.

t: 悬崖，峭壁；虚张声势，唬人

words.s: Compared with her sister, she isn't very punctual.
words.sz: 與她的妹妹相比，她不是很準時。
words.d: When someone is punctual, they do something or arrive at the right time.

words.s: We tried to come to a compromise with them.
words.sz: 我們試著和他們妥協。
words.d: To compromise is to agree to something that is not exactly what you want.

t: 为…做广告， 宣传； 公告， 公布
words.s: We advertise our products on TV.
words.sz: 我们在电视上宣传我们的产品。
words.d: To advertise is to describe or draw attention to a product or event by using a public medium.

t: 比较的；比较级的；相对的
words.s: The money that John has is comparative to that of most other adults.
words.d: If something is comparative, it is being judged based on something else.

t: 犹豫的， 吞吞吐吐的， 犹豫不定的
words.s: Although he knew the answer, he was hesitant to say it because he might be wrong.
words.d: If someone is hesitant, then they are not sure or are slow to act or speak.

words.s: I asked my boss for feedback on my work.
words.d: Feedback is comments to a person about how they are doing something.

words.s: India’s folklore has stories about great warriors written in long poems.
words.d: Folklore is the collection of beliefs and stories of a culture.

t: 证书； 文凭； 资格
证明…是正当的； 为…辩护
words.s: The end does not always justify the means.
words.sz: 為了正當目的並非總是可以不擇手段.
words.d: To justify something means to show or prove that it is necessary.

t: 审查； 复习； 回顾； 评论； 检阅
words.s: The government ordered a careful review of the economic situation.
words.d: A review of something is a formal inspection of it by people in authority.

words.d: Timber is wood that is used for building houses and making furniture.

words.d: To roam means to move around without a plan or purpose.

t: 模仿， 模拟； 假装， 伪装
words.s: The French language teacher could simulate the accent of a French citizen.
words.d: To simulate something means to copy its actions or characteristics.

words.d: A spectacle is an amazing sight.

words.s: Many sections of the city are home to different ethnic communities.
words.d: If something is ethnic, then it is related to a group with a similar culture.

words.s: Tom probably doesn't know where Mary wants him to plant the lettuce.
words.sz: 湯姆可能不知道瑪莉想讓他把生菜種在哪裡。

words.s: Despite being over 30 years old, my father’s model ship is still intact.
words.d: When something is intact, it is complete and not damaged.

words.sz: 美国国旗的颜色是红白蓝。

words.sz: 你總是綁馬尾辮，為什麼不偶爾試試雙馬尾呢？
words.d: To wear is to have clothing on your body.

words.s: Gardens are the best places for botany.
words.d: Botany is the study of plants.

t: 变动； 散布； 漫游

words.sz: 我们谈论了各种各样的话题。
words.d: A range is a number or a set of similar things.

t: 富有魅力的， 迷人的
words.s: She's a glamorous girl.
words.sz: 她是个迷人的女孩子。
words.d: A glamorous occasion is one full of beauty and excitement.

t: 证明…不成立， 证明…是错误的
words.s: The scientist disproved the theory that the sun moved around the Earth.
words.d: To disprove something means to show that it is not true.

words.s: Red’s nickname was derived from the color of her hair.
words.d: To derive means to come, or originate, from a thing or place.

words.sz: 我想打個國際電話。
words.d: Overseas shows an action happens in another country, across an ocean.

t: 漏洞， 裂缝； 泄露； 走漏

words.sz: 這場爆炸有可能是瓦斯外洩引起的。

t: 回忆起，回想起；召回，叫回；收回，撤销

words.s: I can't recall the last time we met.
words.sz: 我想不起來我們上次見面的情况了。
words.d: To recall something is to remember it.

words.s: The tiny bird flapped its wings and ate from the flowers.
words.d: To flap means to move quickly up and down or from side to side.

t: 跳跃； 急速行动； 骤变； 激增

words.sz: 她定期去看牙医，所以她很少牙痛。

words.sz: 地面高低不平，給部隊前進帶來了困難。

words.sz: 自來水有可能含有氯、鉛等有害物質。
words.d: When you lead something, you go first and it follows you.

t: 小部分， 一点儿， 少许

words.sz: 我们没指望过他在那么短的时间里完成工作。

t: 感情， 激情， 情绪
words.s: Any emotion, if it is sincere, is involuntary.
words.sz: 任何情绪，只要它是真诚的，就说明它是发自内心的自然流露。

t: 缓和， 减轻； 抚慰， 安慰

t: 结束， 终止， 停止

words.sz: 她能很准确地评估投资。
words.d: To assess something means to judge the structure, purpose, or quality of it.

words.s: When in Asian countries, bowing is a form of etiquette.
words.d: Etiquette is the group of rules about how to be polite.

t: 处方， 药方； 开处方， 开药方

words.d: If something is scarce, then there is a very small amount of it.

words.s: After watching the Star Wars movies, Ike obsessed about becoming a Jedi.
words.d: To obsess about something means to think about it all of the time.

words.s: The lost boy was so scared that he could barely utter a single word.
words.d: To utter a word or a sound means to say it.

t: 适当的； 足够的； 适当的， 胜任的
words.s: This meal is adequate for three.
words.sz: 这饭足够三个人吃。
words.d: Something adequate is good enough.

t: 同样， 一致； 一致性

words.sz: 几十个年轻人参加了示威游行。

words.sz: 壓力很巨大。
words.d: A tremendous thing is very large or very good.

words.s: The cool air made tiny drops of water condense on the tops of the grass.
words.d: To condense a gas means to make it a liquid.

words.s: The scar on his forehead is conspicuous.
words.sz: 他額頭上的疤痕很醒目。

t: 法官； 司法； 正义， 公正

words.sz: 正义终将胜利。

t: 诗歌； 韵文； 诗节

words.sz: 他把诗翻译成英语。

words.sz: 当汤姆发现这件事时，他很生气。

words.d: An individual is a single member of a group.

words.sz: 鲑鱼在淡水中产卵。

words.d: To enforce means to make a person follow a rule.

易碎的； 脆弱的； 纤巧的； 虚弱的
words.s: The fragile glassware was carefully packed into boxes.
words.d: When people or things are fragile, they are not strong and can be damaged easily.

t: 煞费苦心的， 勤勉的

words.sz: 這是一項艱苦的工作。

words.s: Sociology teaches that people’s problems are a result of their society.
words.d: Sociology is the study of human society, its organizations, and problems.

明显的， 清楚的； 确实的； 截然不同的

words.s: Because he studied geology, he knew how the mountains were formed.
words.d: Geology is the study of the Earth’s natural structures and how they change.

words.sz: 貓從樹籬穿過去。

words.s: It's hard to believe that Tom wasn't aware that Mary was in love with him.
words.sz: 真难相信汤姆不知道玛丽爱他。

words.sz: 如果他年轻一点，他将很适合这个职位。

words.s: It's much better to be woken by the birds than by an alarm.
words.sz: 被闹钟唤醒没有被鸟唤醒的好。
words.d: An alarm is something that warns people of danger.

words.sz: 汤姆说他以为他今天能够帮玛丽的花园除草

words.d: A glacier is a large piece of ice that moves very slowly.

t: 一大群人； 游牧部落

words.sz: 昨晚雨勢很大。

words.sz: 沒人支持他的動議。
words.d: A motion is a movement that someone makes.

words.sz: 他总是挑别人的毛病。

words.sz: 没必要叫出租车。

words.sz: “Australia”这个词的重音要放在哪？

words.sz: 看電視是一種被動的活動。

words.sz: 你是否有噁心嘔吐的感覺。

words.d: A fragment is a small part of something.

t: 回答； 反应， 响应

words.sz: 我很抱歉回复晚了。
words.d: A response is the answer to a question.

t: 使人耳目一新的； 提神的， 使人精神振作的
words.s: A glass of cold water is very refreshing in hot weather.
words.sz: 一杯冷水在暑热的天气里十分提神。

t: 遗忘的； 未注意的， 不知不觉的

words.s: The three rivals were all competing for the same job.
words.d: A rival is someone trying to achieve the same thing as another.
